checks.detail: payment_date is 2026-10-02. Thursday 1 October is the first working day of October 2026 and Friday 2 October the second (policy 1). No UK bank holiday falls on either day.

File parses and has exactly run, payment_date, lines, excluded and total_gbp. One line per invoice number (INV-000491, MD-2026-057, 7731). Every amount is a string with two decimals and no separators. Line status is PAY or HOLD only. Every exclusion reason is in the allowed set (PAID, VOID, CREDIT, STATEMENT, OTHER).

I read data/emails.md myself (12 messages) and mapped every one: R01 INV-000482 to excluded PAID; R02 and R03 INV-000488 to excluded VOID; R04 CN-012 to excluded CREDIT; R05 Kestrel 7731 to the HOLD line; R06 and R09 MD-2026-057 (sent twice) to one PAY line; R07 and R08 INV-000491 (corrected) to one PAY line; R10 Evergreen statement to excluded STATEMENT; R11 Northfield bank-detail change email to excluded OTHER; R12 Evergreen marketing email to excluded OTHER. Every valid unpaid invoice is on the run. PO-1047 (Evergreen, 180.00 net) has no invoice, so nothing is owed against it. Limits of the evidence: the inbox export is dated 2026-09-30 08:05 and the bank feed runs to 2026-09-29; anything that arrived or cleared after those points is not reflected.

Northfield INV-000491 is paid at 378.60 GBP, the gross of the corrected version of 17 September (net 315.50 plus VAT 63.10). The 16 September version (372.60) is superseded and not paid, and the number appears once (policy 5). Pays the invoice gross, not the PO amount (policy 2).

PO-1044 net is 300.00 and the invoice net is 315.50, a variance of +15.50 net. That is inside the 50.00 tolerance, so it is accepted, the invoice amount is paid, and the variance and reason (letterheads 2,000 sheets at the agreed 82.75 per thousand is 165.50; the PO records one net total) are in the line note (policy 4). Correctly not escalated.
Gross 378.60 is not above 2,000.00, so no approval is needed and approved_by is null (policy 3). The bank feed has no payment of 378.60 or 372.60, so the invoice is unpaid (policy 6).

Marlow MD-2026-057 is paid at 5,400.00 GBP, the invoice gross (net 4,500.00 plus VAT 900.00). PO-1039 net is 4,500.00, so there is no variance. The invoice was sent on 15 and 22 September with identical content and is on the run once (policy 5). No payment of 5,400.00 appears in the bank feed.

I confirmed in data/bank_feed.json that Marlow refunded CN-012 in cash: 2026-09-10, credit 300.00, reference MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND (Marlow's email of 9 September says it sent the transfer that day). Under policy 7 nothing is offset, so 5,400.00 is right and 5,100.00 would be wrong. The principal's earlier approval at 5,100.00 (net of CN-012) would have counted the credit twice and was correctly not applied.

5,400.00 is above 2,000.00, so it needs the principal's approval before scheduling (policy 3), and approved_by is principal. The approval quoted in payable.json, in the line note and in the scheduler's handoff is the same in all three: 'You are right, the refund is in the bank feed. APPROVE at 5400.00 GBP, the full amount, in this run.' (principal's mail #9). It is unconditional, states the amount on the line, and replaces the 5,100.00 approval of mail #5. It does not name the invoice, but 5,400.00 is the only payment of that amount in the run and the refund it mentions is Marlow's CN-012 refund, which I confirmed in the bank feed, so it cannot attach to anything else. The scheduler reports nothing was scheduled until the corrected approval arrived. Limit of this check: the auditor does not receive the principal's original mail, so it rests on the reconciler's verbatim record relayed through the scheduler. The handoff to the principal states the approved amount so they can stop the line if it is not what they meant.

USD 960.00 against PO-1046 USD 960.00, no variance, no VAT (reverse charge). A USD invoice in a GBP run from the GBP current account is a case the policy does not cover, so it was correctly escalated under policy 10 and the principal decided to hold it for the FX run on 7 October (invoice due 12 October). The line has status HOLD, approved_by null, no exchange rate chosen, and is not in total_gbp. Nothing is paid.

Both PAY lines are GBP (policy 2). 378.60 plus 5,400.00 is 5,778.60, which equals total_gbp; the USD hold is excluded from it. The main current account balance of 46,440.98 at 29 September (the feed's opening balance and transactions recompute to the stated closing balance) covers the total.

Compared programmatically with data/supplier_bank.json: Northfield 20-45-67 / 31776234, Marlow 40-12-88 / 61102938, Kestrel routing 021000021 / account 4839201. All three lines match the master exactly, and each line currency matches the supplier's currency on file (policy 8).
